110/**
111 * Used to load, store, and display images stored in a database.
112 * When an image is loaded it is {@link #bestFit() } and stays
113 * that way if the image is resized;
114 * zooming takes it out of best fit mode.
115 * There are controls available for zooming the image and support for an
116 * image popup menu. A subset may be partially/fully displayed by a subclass.
117 * See {@link #imageControls() } and {@link #createImagePopup() }.
118 * Available controls are
119 * {@link #getUpdateButton() },
120 * {@link #getZoomSlider() },
121 * {@link #getZoomResetButton() },
122 * {@link #getCurrentZoomLabel() }.
123 *
124 * <p>
125 * Though not visible in the API, there's a {@link ZoomCanvas} in the scroll pane.
126 */
127// TODO: SsImage make all the load/store buttons/capabilities optional.
128@SuppressWarnings("serial")
129public class SsImage extends JPanel implements SsComponent, ScrollPaneConstants {
130  // TODO: try to get this initialized
131  private Path path;
132  /**
133   * This listener can read a file; create an image from the file;
134   * write the image bits to the database, display the image.
135   * The first step puts up a FileChooser.
136   */
137  protected class ImageListener implements ActionListener {
138    /** {@inheritDoc} */
139    @Override
140    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent ae) {
141      if (getRowSet() == null) // TODO: is this check needed?
142        return;
143
144      JFileChooser fc = new JFileChooser();
145      if (fc.showOpenDialog(btnUpdateImage) != JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) {
146        return;
147      }
148
149      Path tPath = fc.getSelectedFile().toPath();
150      java.awt.Image image;
151      try {
152        image = createDbImageFromFile(tPath);
153      } catch (IOException ioe) {
154        SsUtils.reportError(logger, SsImage.this, "Error accessing image file", tPath, ioe);
155        return;
156      } catch (SQLException ex) {
157        logger.log(Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
158        return;
159      }
160
161      // Display the image
162      path = tPath;
163
164      setImage(image);
165    }
166
167    private java.awt.Image createDbImageFromFile(Path tPath) throws SQLException, IOException {
168      // Read the image into a byte array
169      ByteBuffer bb;
170      try (SeekableByteChannel rbc = Files.newByteChannel(tPath, EnumSet.of(READ))) {
171        int totalLength = (int) rbc.size();
172        bb = ByteBuffer.allocate(totalLength);
173        int bytesRead = rbc.read(bb);
174        if (totalLength != bytesRead)
175          throw new IOException(sf("Image expected %d bytes, got %d", totalLength, bytesRead));
176      }
177      byte[] bytes = bb.array();
178
179      // Verify the bytes are a recognized image
180      BufferedImage bimg = ZoomCanvas.bytes2image(bytes);
181      if (bimg == null)
182        throw new IOException("Unknown image format");
183
184      // Stage the image to the database
185      dbChange(() -> { setColumn(bytes); });
186
187      return bimg;
188    }
189  } // end private class ImageListener

260  /**
261   * Easy way to set scroll bar policy for both directions. For example
262   * {@snippet lang="java":
263   * ALWAYS.setPolicy(scrollPane);
264   * }
265   */
266  public enum ScrollBarPolicy {
267    /** scroll bars always. */
268    ALWAYS,
269    /** scroll bars as needed. */
270    AS_NEEDED,
271    /** never have scroll bars. */
272    NEVER;
273
274    /**
275     * Apply specified policy.
276     * @param jsp target scroll pane
277     */
278    public void setPolicy(JScrollPane jsp) {
279      jsp.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(switch (this) {
280        case ALWAYS -> HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS;
281        case AS_NEEDED -> HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED;
282        case NEVER -> HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER;
283      });
284      jsp.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(switch (this) {
285        case ALWAYS -> VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS;
286        case AS_NEEDED -> VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED;
287        case NEVER -> VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER;
288      });
289    }
290  }

309  private void setupImageCanvasInScrollPane() {
310    canvas = new MyZoomCanvas(scrollPane,
311                              () -> zoomFactor,
312                              () -> zoomSlider.getValueIsAdjusting()
313                                         ? ZoomCanvas.RenderingQuality.MEDIUM
314                                         : ZoomCanvas.RenderingQuality.HIGH);
315    nullBackground = canvas.getBackground();
316    scrollPane.getViewport().setView(canvas);
317
318    setImageToolTipText("""
319        <html> Drag to pan image.
320        <br>Try the context menu.
321        </html>""");
322
323    // Panning - click and drag image around.
324    // Also used for popup.
325    canvasMouseListener = new CanvasMouseListener();
326
327    // Listeners must be added to both tracking pools for drag movements to register
328    canvas.addMouseListener(canvasMouseListener);
329    canvas.addMouseMotionListener(canvasMouseListener);
330  }
331
332  private class CanvasMouseListener extends MouseAdapter {
333    private Point origin; // Stores where the mouse drag started
334
335    @Override
336    public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) { // Panning
337      // Capture the starting mouse point, and popup point
338      origin = e.getPoint();
339      requestFocusInWindow();
340      if (tryPopup(e))
341        return;
342
343      // Change cursor to a hand/grabbing cursor when clicking down
344      canvas.setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(Cursor.MOVE_CURSOR));
345    }
346
347    @Override
348    public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent e) { // Panning
349      // Capture popup point
350      origin = e.getPoint();
351      if (tryPopup(e))
352        return;
353
354      // Restore standard default cursor when letting go
355      canvas.setCursor(Cursor.getDefaultCursor());
356    }
357
358    @Override
359    public void mouseDragged(MouseEvent e) { // Panning
360      if (origin == null)
361        return;
362
363      JViewport viewport = scrollPane.getViewport();
364      Point viewPos = viewport.getViewPosition();
365
366      // Calculate how many pixels the mouse moved from the starting origin
367      int deltaX = origin.x - e.getX();
368      int deltaY = origin.y - e.getY();
369
370      // Shift the viewport view position by that delta
371      int newX = viewPos.x + deltaX;
372      int newY = viewPos.y + deltaY;
373
374      // Clamp the scroll bounds to prevent scrolling past image borders
375      int maxX = canvas.getWidth() - viewport.getWidth();
376      int maxY = canvas.getHeight() - viewport.getHeight();
377
378      if (newX < 0)
379        newX = 0;
380      if (newY < 0)
381        newY = 0;
382      if (newX > maxX)
383        newX = Math.max(0, maxX);
384      if (newY > maxY)
385        newY = Math.max(0, maxY);
386
387      viewport.setViewPosition(new Point(newX, newY));
388    }
389  }
390
391  private CanvasMouseListener canvasMouseListener;
392
393  /** @return true if a popupTrigger */
394  private boolean tryPopup(MouseEvent e) {
395    if (!e.isPopupTrigger())
396      return false;
397    JPopupMenu imagePopup = createImagePopup();
398    if (imagePopup != null) {
399      Point pos = e.getPoint();
400      imagePopup.show(e.getComponent(), pos.x, pos.y);
401    }
402    return true;
403  }

414  /**

417  protected JPopupMenu createImagePopup() {
418    JPopupMenu imagePopup = new JPopupMenu();
419    imagePopup.add(menuAction("Center mouse point", () -> {
420      canvas.centerViewportOnCanvasPoint(canvasMouseListener.origin);
421    }));
422    imagePopup.add(menuAction("Fit image", () -> { bestFit(); }));
423    imagePopup.add(menuAction("Zoom factor 1.0", () -> { resetZoom(); }));
424    return imagePopup;
425  }

548  /**
549   * Updates the value stored and displayed in the SwingSet component based on
550   * getColumnText().
551   * <p>
552   * Call to this method should be coming from SSCommon and should already have
553   * the Component listener removed.
554   */
555  public void updateComponent() {
556    java.awt.Image image;
557    try {
558      byte[] imageData = (byte[]) getColumn();
559
560      if (imageData != null) {
561        logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: Setting non-null image.", getColumnForLog()));
562        image = ZoomCanvas.bytes2image(imageData);
563      } else {
564        logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: Setting null image.", getColumnForLog()));
565        image = null;
566      }
567    } catch (SQLException | IOException ex) {
568      logger.log(Level.ERROR, getColumnForLog() + ": Exception.", ex);
569      image = null;
570    }
571
572    setImage(image);
573  }

579  private String getImageFormat(ImageInputStream iis) throws IOException {
580    String formatName = null;
581    Iterator<ImageReader> readers = ImageIO.getImageReaders(iis);
582    if (readers.hasNext()) {
583      ImageReader reader = readers.next();
584      formatName = reader.getFormatName(); // Returns "JPEG", "png", etc.
585      //System.out.println("SsImage Format: " + formatName);
586
587      // Optionally continue reading the image with the same reader
588      //reader.setInput(iis);
589      //BufferedImage image = reader.read(0);
590    } else
591      throw new IOException("Unknown image format");
592    return formatName;
593  }

647  private boolean keepFit;

649  // Slider constants
650  private static final int MIN_SLIDER = 10;
651  private static final int MAX_SLIDER = 400;
652  private static final int INIT_SLIDER = 100;
653  private static final double MIN_ZOOM = 0.1;
654  private static final double MAX_ZOOM = 4.0;
655
656  /** zoom slider. */
657  private JSlider zoomSlider;
658  /** current zoom */
659  private JLabel currentZoomLabel;
660  /** set zoom to 1, no zoom */
661  private JButton sliderResetButton;
662  private boolean isUpdatingControls = false; // Prevents recursive listener execution
663
664  private Point lockedViewportCenter = null;
665  private double zoomFactorAtClick = 1.0;
666
667  // Update your JSlider constructor and listeners inside the main constructor:
668  private void setupSlider() {
669    zoomSlider = new JSlider(JSlider.HORIZONTAL, MIN_SLIDER, MAX_SLIDER, INIT_SLIDER);
670    zoomSlider.setMajorTickSpacing(100);
671    zoomSlider.setMinorTickSpacing(25);
672    // zoomSlider.setPaintTicks(true);
673    // zoomSlider.setPaintLabels(true);
674
675    // 1. Capture the visual center point ONCE when the user clicks/presses the slider
676    zoomSlider.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
677      @Override
678      public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) {
679        // calculate the TRUE image center. Taking into account
680        // the padding added because the image is CENTERED
681
682        zoomFactorAtClick = zoomFactor;
683        lockedViewportCenter = canvas.captureImagePointAtViewportCenter();
684
685        logger.log(Level.DEBUG, sf("zoomAtClick %.2f, locked %s", zoomFactorAtClick,
686                                   lockedViewportCenter.toString()));
687
688        // Show the tooltip immediately upon user clicking down
689        updateFloatingTooltip();
690      }
691
692      @Override
693      public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent e) {
694        // Clear the anchor lock when the user releases the slider
695        lockedViewportCenter = null;
696
697        // Hide the tooltip seamlessly when user releases the slider handle
698        hideFloatingTooltip();
699        canvas.repaint();
700      }
701    });
702
703    // 2. Continuous updates while dragging use the LOCKED anchor point
704    zoomSlider.addChangeListener(e -> {
705      if (!isUpdatingControls) {
706        setKeepFit(false); // User's zooming.
707        double targetZoom = zoomSlider.getValue() / 100.0;
708        updateZoom(targetZoom);
709
710        // Force the tooltip to refresh text and update X coordinates
711        // dynamically while dragging
712        if (zoomSlider.getValueIsAdjusting()) {
713          updateFloatingTooltip();
714        }
715      }
716    });
717  }

780  private void setImage(java.awt.Image newImage) {
781    if (newImage == null) {
782      canvas.setBackground(nullBackground);
783      setBufferedImage(null);
784      updateZoom(0);
785      return;
786    }
787    canvas.setBackground(imageBackground);
788
789    // 1. Convert to BufferedImage if it isn't one already to ensure stable measurement
790    if (newImage instanceof BufferedImage bufferedImage) {
791      setBufferedImage(bufferedImage);
792    } else {
793      // Create an empty buffered image with the correct pixel channels
794      BufferedImage bImage = new BufferedImage(newImage.getWidth(null), newImage.getHeight(null),
795                                               BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
796      Graphics2D g2d = bImage.createGraphics();
797      g2d.drawImage(newImage, 0, 0, null);
798      g2d.dispose();
799      setBufferedImage(ZoomCanvas.toCompatibleImage(bImage));
800    }
801
802    // 2. Calculate the optimal "Fit" zoom factor
803    // We target the parent scroll pane's viewport size. If the window isn't
804    // layout-rendered yet,
805    // we fall back to standard 1.0 (100%) scaling.
806
807    bestFit();
808  }
809
810  private void setKeepFit(boolean keepFit) {
811    this.keepFit = keepFit;
812    if (keepFit)
813      NEVER.setPolicy(scrollPane);
814    else
815      ALWAYS.setPolicy(scrollPane);
816  }
817
818  // To get the viewort size exactly can do various things
819  // Note jsp.revalidate(); jsp.validate(); is not safe since from event
820  // could cause layout loops.
821  // 1. invokeLater, then that's after relayout.
822  // 2. manually subtract the scrollpane insets from the scrollpan.
823
824  /**
825   * Zoom the image so that it's as big as possible
826   * and fits inside the scrollPane.
827   */
828  protected void bestFit() {
829    if (originalImage == null)
830      return;
831    setKeepFit(true);
832    // let the scrollbar layout settle
833    // Using invokeLater so layout settles, gets a visible double draw.
834    laterBestFit();
835  }
836
837  private void laterBestFit() {
838    // For best fit, use the entire scrollPane area. The scrollBars may still be
839    // present, even though they were turned off in setKeepFit(). To use
840    // scrollPane.getViewport().getSize(), need to wait for layout to settle,
841    // by using invokeLater, but that produces visual artifacts with double draw.
842    //
843    // Instead manually calculate the viewport area from the scrollPane.
844
845    Insets insets = scrollPane.getInsets();
846    int viewwidth = scrollPane.getSize().width - insets.left - insets.right;
847    int viewheight = scrollPane.getSize().height - insets.top - insets.bottom;
848    double targetZoom;
849
850    if (viewwidth > 0 && viewheight > 0) {
851      // Take the smaller ratio to ensure the image is entirely visible
852      double widthRatio = (double) viewwidth / originalImage.getWidth();
853      double heightRatio = (double) viewheight / originalImage.getHeight();
854      targetZoom = Math.min(widthRatio, heightRatio);
855
856      // Safety bounds checks to ensure it complies with our UI Slider
857      // constraints (10% to 400%)
858      if (targetZoom < MIN_ZOOM)
859        targetZoom = MIN_ZOOM;
860      if (targetZoom > MAX_ZOOM)
861        targetZoom = MAX_ZOOM;
862    } else {
863      // Does this belong here? Shoudl it be in setImage?
864      redoImageWithDimensions();
865      return;
866    }
867    // Initialize fitting zoom without anchoring corrections
868    updateZoom(capZoom(targetZoom));
869
870    // Snap scrollbars cleanly to center for best fit
871    centerScrollPane();
872  }
873
874  private double capZoom(double targetZ) {
875    double targetZoom = targetZ;
876    if (targetZoom < MIN_ZOOM)
877      targetZoom = MIN_ZOOM;
878    if (targetZoom > MAX_ZOOM)
879      targetZoom = MAX_ZOOM;
880    return targetZoom;
881  }
882
883  /**
884   * Executes a one-shot zoom adjustment while anchoring
885   * the transformation to the current visual center.
886   * @param targetZoom
887   */
888  protected void zoomOneShot(double targetZoom) {
889    if (originalImage == null)
890      return;
891    setKeepFit(false); // User's zooming.
892
893    this.zoomFactorAtClick = this.zoomFactor;
894    this.lockedViewportCenter = canvas.captureImagePointAtViewportCenter();
895
896    // Do the zoom, then clear state.
897    updateZoom(capZoom(targetZoom));
898    this.lockedViewportCenter = null;
899  }
900
901  /** Set the zoom to 1.0 */
902  protected void resetZoom() {
903    // Snaps cleanly back to standard 100% dimensions without drifting
904    zoomOneShot(1.0);
905  }
906
907  private void reportZoom() {
908    currentZoomLabel.setText(sf("%.2f", zoomFactor));
909  }
910
911  // Ensures the hidden or visible slider matches the current zoom calculation
912  private void syncSliderUI() {
913    isUpdatingControls = true;
914    zoomSlider.setValue((int) (zoomFactor * 100));
915    isUpdatingControls = false;
916  }
917
918  private void updateZoom(double newZoomFactor) {
919    this.zoomFactor = newZoomFactor;
920    reportZoom();
921
922    // Sync Slider
923    syncSliderUI();
924
925    if (originalImage == null)
926      return;
927
928    // Trigger immediate layout recalculation and screen redraw
929    canvas.revalidate();
930    canvas.repaint();
931
932    // Process scrollbar locking using the anchor point
933    if (lockedViewportCenter != null && zoomFactorAtClick > 0) {
934      double cumulativeScaleChange = zoomFactor / zoomFactorAtClick;
935
936      int projectedAnchorX = (int) (lockedViewportCenter.x * cumulativeScaleChange);
937      int projectedAnchorY = (int) (lockedViewportCenter.y * cumulativeScaleChange);
938
939      Dimension viewSize = scrollPane.getViewport().getSize();
940      int newImgWidth = (int) (originalImage.getWidth() * zoomFactor);
941      int newImgHeight = (int) (originalImage.getHeight() * zoomFactor);
942
943      int futureLabelWidth = Math.max(viewSize.width, newImgWidth);
944      int futureLabelHeight = Math.max(viewSize.height, newImgHeight);
945
946      int futureOffsetX = (futureLabelWidth - newImgWidth) / 2;
947      int futureOffsetY = (futureLabelHeight - newImgHeight) / 2;
948
949      Point targetScrollPos = new Point((projectedAnchorX + futureOffsetX) - viewSize.width / 2,
950                                        (projectedAnchorY + futureOffsetY) - viewSize.height / 2);
951
952      // Update scrollbars smoothly in sync with the repaint
953      scrollPane.getViewport().setViewPosition(targetScrollPos);
954    }
955  }
956
957  /** Force the scroll pane to reset its scroll bars to the middle */
958  protected void centerScrollPane() {
959    SwingUtilities.invokeLater(this::centerScrollbarsInstantly);
960  }
961
962  private void centerScrollbarsInstantly() {
963    scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar().setValue(
964        (scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar().getMaximum()
965         - scrollPane.getHorizontalScrollBar().getVisibleAmount())
966        / 2);
967    scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(
968        (scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().getMaximum()
969         - scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar().getVisibleAmount())
970        / 2);
971  }
972
973  /**
974   * When the viewport is laid out, re-set the image.
975   */
976  protected void redoImageWithDimensions() {
977    logger.log(DEBUG, "Start listening for viewport size");
978    scrollPane.getViewport().addComponentListener(new ComponentAdapter() {
979      @Override
980      public void componentResized(ComponentEvent e) {
981        // Triggered as soon as the viewport gets its initial size
982
983        JViewport viewport = (JViewport) e.getComponent();
984        Dimension size = viewport.getSize();
985        if (size.height > 0 && size.width > 0) {
986          setImage(originalImage);
987          // Remove the listener, only need the initial size once
988          viewport.removeComponentListener(this);
989          logger.log(DEBUG, "Stop listening for viewport size");
990        } else
991          logger.log(DEBUG, "Keep listening for viewport size");
992      }
993    });
994  }
995
996  ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
997  //
998  // Popup over slider thumb with zoom factor.
999  //
1000
1001  // import javax.swing.JToolTip;
1002  // import javax.swing.Popup;
1003  // import javax.swing.PopupFactory;
1004
1005  // ... inside your ImageZoomApp class ...
1006  private JToolTip customTooltip;
1007  private Popup tooltipPopup;
1008
1009  private void updateFloatingTooltip() {
1010    hideFloatingTooltip();
1011
1012    if (zoomSlider == null || !zoomSlider.isShowing())
1013      return;
1014
1015    if (customTooltip == null) {
1016      customTooltip = zoomSlider.createToolTip();
1017    }
1018
1019    // Set active text layout format (e.g., "150%")
1020    customTooltip.setTipText((int) (zoomFactor * 100) + "%");
1021
1022    // --- ACCURATE MATHEMATICAL THUMB-X CALCULATION ---
1023
1024    // 1. Determine total component dimensions
1025    int sliderWidth = zoomSlider.getWidth();
1026    int min = zoomSlider.getMinimum();
1027    int max = zoomSlider.getMaximum();
1028    int val = zoomSlider.getValue();
1029
1030    // 2. Establish approximate standard UI padding offsets
1031    // Swing horizontal sliders reserve a small padding margin on the left/right
1032    // edges so the thumb graphic doesn't visually bleed outside the component frame.
1033    int trackPaddingLeft = 10;
1034    int trackPaddingRight = 10;
1035    int usableWidth = sliderWidth - (trackPaddingLeft + trackPaddingRight);
1036
1037    // 3. Compute relative percentage placement
1038    double positionPercentage = (double) (val - min) / (max - min);
1039
1040    // 4. Trace the pixel center coordinate of the thumb
1041    int thumbX = trackPaddingLeft + (int) (positionPercentage * usableWidth);
1042
1043    // --- SCREEN MATRIX TRANSLATION ---
1044
1045    // Translate local slider coordinates out to global OS screen coordinates
1046    Point sliderScreenPos = zoomSlider.getLocationOnScreen();
1047
1048    // Center alignment adjustment: Subtract half of the tooltip viewwidth
1049    // so the floating bubble balances directly over the thumb's core center-axis.
1050    int tooltipHalfWidth = customTooltip.getPreferredSize().width / 2;
1051    int popupX = sliderScreenPos.x + thumbX - tooltipHalfWidth;
1052    int popupY
1053        = sliderScreenPos.y - customTooltip.getPreferredSize().height - 5; // 5px padding above
1054
1055    // Generate and reveal the absolute overlay panel window safely
1056    tooltipPopup
1057        = PopupFactory.getSharedInstance().getPopup(zoomSlider, customTooltip, popupX, popupY);
1058    tooltipPopup.show();
1059  }
1060
1061  private void hideFloatingTooltip() {
1062    if (tooltipPopup != null) {
1063      tooltipPopup.hide();
1064      tooltipPopup = null;
1065    }
1066  }
1067}
